qq_message_enable_help: Query the welfare detection plugin's opening status for today during the query window. Stop querying after a match, including after restart; permission expires at Beijing midnight. Start when idle or after the current task ends. Weekday, daily attempt and rest settings apply. Configure group, member and keywords in the plugin.
qq_query_start_time_help: Beijing time, default 20:00. Windows across midnight are supported; equal start/end times mean all day.
qq_query_end_time_help: Beijing time, default 22:00. Stop new queries at this time; an already matched dojo still runs after the current task ends.
qq_poll_interval_help: Default 60 seconds; enter 1 to 86400. Query only during the configured window and stop for the day after a match. Retry failed requests at this interval.
min_people_num_help: Only select dojos with the Xin emblem. Halve the minimum defender count once refreshes exceed the configured count.
find_dokan_refresh_count: Refreshes before reducing the defender threshold
find_dokan_refresh_count_help: Halve the minimum defender count once refreshes exceed this value. Stop for the day after 20 refreshes if none qualify and send an alert using dojo notification settings.
push_reward_images_help: At the end of each dojo task run, send the date and all reward screenshots from that run, then delete them after successful delivery. When disabled, screenshots are saved but not sent or deleted. Enable dojo notifications and configure a go-cqhttp channel to send images.
task_notify_enable_help: Controls all notifications for this task.
task_notify_config_help: Enter the channel and recipient in YAML, using the same format as global notifications, with a space after each colon. Leave blank to use the global configuration and switch. A custom configuration works independently of the global switch. Dojo screenshots require go-cqhttp; other channels send text only for FrogBoss.
name: Task group name
task_group_name_help: Name of this task group, only used for display and logs (e.g. Daily, Souls, Event).
task_group_tasks_help: Tasks run from top to bottom in the order shown: use Add task to append one, drag the handle to reorder, and click the cross to remove one. Group tasks do not need to be enabled individually; if enabled, they also enter the scheduler on their own schedule.
task_group_stop_on_error_help: Enabled: stop the remaining tasks when a task in the group fails. Disabled: skip the failed task, keep running the rest and mark the group run as failed.
task_group_start_index_help: 1 (default) runs the whole group from the first item. When a run stops because item N failed, this is set to N automatically, so the next run continues from item N and does not repeat the finished ones; it is reset to 1 after the whole group finishes. You can also set it by hand, e.g. 3 starts from the third item.
shikigami_class_help: Class of shikigami to use (N is suggested). Choose 默认 (default) to keep the class currently selected in game and never switch the rarity filter.
itachi_coin_buy_jade_help: Buy the auto-forwarded Itachi gift boxes. Each box is opened only once; if the purchase dialog does not appear within three seconds, the weekly shop is treated as already purchased.
skip_when_weekly_goal_reached: Skip Duel after this week's goal
duel_weekly_goal_skip_help: After reaching the score, celebrity star, or honor goal, skip Duel for the rest of the week. When disabled, later completions use the normal interval.
duel_weekly_goal_date_help: Automatically saved as YYYY-MM-DD and cleared when a new week starts. A date in the current week skips Duel before it starts. Clear it to run Duel manually again this week.
stop_when_wanxiang_exhausted: Stop when Wanxiang Blessings run out
stop_when_wanxiang_exhausted_help: Before each run, read the Wanxiang Blessing count in the top right. Stop when it reaches zero, ignoring the run count and time limits.
save_ocr_log_help: Disabled by default. When enabled, saves OCR input images and recognized text for debugging.
quick_loadout_enable_help: Equip preset souls and deploy the preset from the in-battle quick loadout panel; skips the legacy soul switch and battle preset, then applies the team-lock state from general battle settings
quick_loadout_mode_help: mode_number selects by group and preset number; mode_ocr selects by group and preset name
quick_loadout_group_number_help: Preset group number in the quick loadout panel
quick_loadout_preset_number_help: Preset number in the selected group
quick_loadout_group_name_help: Preset group name used in OCR mode
quick_loadout_preset_name_help: Preset name used in OCR mode
quick_loadout_custom_preset_enable_help: Select quick-loadout presets by stage name; deploy the preset and equip its souls once for each new boss challenge
quick_loadout_custom_preset_help: Format: boss_name:("group number or name","preset number or name"); separate entries with semicolons; ALL matches every monster not explicitly configured; OCR mode treats both values as names
before_end_frog_help: Seven two-hour rounds run daily from 10:00 to 24:00 Beijing time. With 00:10:00, betting is scheduled at 11:50, 13:50, 15:50, 17:50, 19:50, 21:50 and 23:50; the first run also waits for its window. Must be greater than zero and at most two hours. Cron, random float and other running tasks can affect actual start times.
strategy_frog_help: RSS follows Mianlingqi Miao's Dashen posts for today's current round, excluding test-server posts. Left/red selects left; right/blue selects right; a comeback selects the minority. Missing or unavailable primary advice falls back to the majority; equal counts select right. Invalid counts or a closed window postpone betting. Each run reports its result, side and fallback reason; go-cqhttp includes a screenshot after the bet is confirmed.
cron_help: Crontab expression: minute hour day month weekday. Leave empty to keep the original success/failure interval behaviour; when set, the task only starts at the times matched by the expression (the random float below still applies). Examples: 0 5 * * * (daily 05:00), 30 20 * * 1 (Monday 20:30), */30 9-23 * * * (every 30 minutes between 09:00 and 23:00), 0 5 1 * * (1st day of each month 05:00). Supports * , - / and names (sun..sat, jan..dec); Sunday is 0 or 7; macros like @daily and @weekly are accepted too.
float_time_help: Random float: the final run time = the computed time + a random 0..this-many seconds. Empty or 00:00:00 disables it; it also applies to crontab rules (e.g. 00:10:00 makes a 05:00 task start somewhere between 05:00 and 05:10).
welfare_plugin_url_help: Full URL, e.g. http://server:2537/welfare-dojo/today. Use the http_port configured in the welfare detection plugin.
welfare_plugin_token_help: The api_token from the welfare detection plugin configuration.
